name: Top-probability R16 team also appears in QF predictions
description: The bracket page shows both Round of 16 and Quarter-final sections with team names, confirming multi-round predictions are populated.

planSteps.description: Find a Round of 16 cell whose predicted winner is the higher-probability team and note that team name
Locate the Quarter-final cell that this Round of 16 winner feeds into

Verify the noted Round of 16 winner appears as a participant in the Quarter-final cell it advances to, confirming the predicted winner actually carries forward across rounds rather than each round listing unrelated teams
